description: Contested/farm detection is weak — the gate can both KEEP fakes and MISS already-claimed bounties. (1) The existing-PR check (run.sh:90) only finds OPEN PRs whose BODY contains '#<num>' via `gh pr list --search "#N in:body"`. It misses PRs that reference the issue in the TITLE or via GitHub's auto-linking, and crucially misses Algora claims made by '/attempt #N' COMMENTS that have no PR yet — so the loop can attempt a bounty another agent already claimed, wasting the work. (2) discover() skips GitHub `assignee` (run.sh:26), but Algora contest happens via /attempt comments, not GitHub assignment, so this filter is largely inert. (3) The farm filter (run.sh:97) only excludes literal repo names test/young/playground/sandbox/demo and 6+ digit numeric owners; a self-funded AI farm with a starred repo and many sequential issues (e.g. the SCIBASE-AI/SCIBASE.AI block of 13 issues in bounties.json) passes the gate. There is no per-funder volume / funder-reputation check, so a sophisticated farm survives as a false-positive 'attemptable' bounty.

evidence.snippet: pl=sh(["gh","pr","list","-R",repo,"--state","open","--search",f"#{num} in:body","--json","number"]) ... if name.lower() in ("test","young","playground","sandbox","demo") or re.fullmatch(r'\d{6,}',owner): continue
